SELECT tipo, chave, dono_id, transcricao,
  CASE tipo WHEN 'leo' THEN nucleo.memoria_resumo(dono_id) WHEN 'gabriel' THEN nucleo.memoria_gabriel(30)
       WHEN 'multi' THEN nucleo.multi_base_resumo()
       ELSE nucleo.base_resumo_agente(tipo) END AS contexto
FROM (SELECT * FROM nucleo.aprendiz_pendentes_todos(25)
      UNION ALL SELECT * FROM nucleo.aprendiz_pendentes_multi(25)) p
WHERE nucleo.aprendiz_pode_rodar()   -- passou do teto do dia: pausa

SELECT CASE
  WHEN $1 LIKE 'erro:%' THEN 0
  WHEN $1 LIKE 'dono:%' THEN nucleo.aprendiz_dono_salvar($3, $1, nullif($4, '')::int, $2::jsonb)
  WHEN $3 = 'leo' THEN nucleo.aprendiz_leo_salvar(nullif($4, '')::int, $1, $2::jsonb)
  WHEN $3 = 'gabriel' THEN nucleo.aprendiz_gabriel_salvar(nullif($4, '')::int, $1, $2::jsonb)
  WHEN $3 IN ('joao', 'suporte') THEN nucleo.aprendiz_salvar_agente(nullif($1, '')::int, $2::jsonb, $3)
  WHEN $3 = 'multi' THEN nucleo.aprendiz_multi_salvar($1, $2::jsonb)
  ELSE 0 END AS salvos,
  CASE WHEN $5 <> '' THEN nucleo.registrar_evento(CASE WHEN $3 IN ('leo', 'joao', 'suporte', 'gabriel') THEN $3 ELSE 'aprendiz' END,
    'aviso', 'Nao consegui aprender de uma conversa: ' || nucleo.motivo_erro($5), $5, jsonb_build_object('conversa', $1)) END AS evento,
  nucleo.perfil_salvar($3, $1, nullif($6, '')::jsonb) AS perfil,
  CASE WHEN coalesce(nullif($7, '')::int, 0) + coalesce(nullif($8, '')::int, 0) > 0
       THEN nucleo.uso_registrar('aprendiz', $3, $9, nullif($7, '')::int, nullif($8, '')::int, 0) END AS uso
SELECT nucleo.rodada_registrar($1::jsonb) AS ok, $2::int AS sugestoes
